- 1-1/2 c. corn meal
- 1 c. flour
- 1 tsp. baking soda
- 1 tsp. baking powder
- 2 eggs (optional: separate and beat egg white until stiff)
- 1/3 c. oil
- 2 c. milk
- ~1-2 tsp. vinegar
